Definition: from G1722 and G5171; to revel in:--sporting selves.
BiblicalUsage: Peter describes false teachers counting it pleasure to riot in the daytime and sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you, in 2 Peter 2:13 — revelling in the very thing that condemns them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the worst deceit is the one enjoyed in the open, at the table with God's people, and the feast will not cover it forever.
